surface_mechanism_description: The binary reaction sequence involves two half-reactions: (A) Si-OH* + SiCl4 --> Si-O-SiCl3 + HCl and (B) SiCl* + H2O --> Si-OH* + HCl. Each half-reaction is complete and self-limiting, leading to layer-by-layer-controlled growth of SiO2.
